record.question: Who was awarded Golden Shoe Award in 2017?
record.explanation: Answer C: Lionel Messi. Lionel Messi received the European Golden Shoe in November 2017 for 37 league goals in the 2016–17 season. His club’s same-day original announcement identifies his fourth award. Historical/source note: European Golden Shoe for 2016–17 league scoring, awarded 2017; not a different tournament’s Golden Boot. Reference: https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/732686/everything-you-need-to-know-about-the-golden-shoe-gala. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
